economic_thesis: In a directional per-symbol auction, the mismatch between closing location and aggressive taker-buy share reveals latent demand or supply. Combining that fixed absorption gap with the contract's own path efficiency should distinguish durable relative leaders and laggards across bull, bear, and chop without a common-factor residual, funding signal, or regime switch.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Efficient relative laggards with negative absorption gaps populate the short sleeve, which is expected to contribute positively; longs are restricted to relatively resilient demand-absorbed auctions.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Efficient relative leaders with positive absorption gaps populate the long sleeve, which is expected to contribute positively; shorts target weak supply-absorbed auctions rather than the broad market direction.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Price efficiency compresses and the independent absorption-gap rank differentiates temporary latent demand and supply; equal side budgets make the combined cross-sectional book responsible for positive return.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Long the highest fixed blend of per-symbol path-efficiency rank and auction-absorption rank at broad equal weights; the sleeve is always material when the portfolio is active and must be positive in bull.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short the lowest fixed blend of per-symbol path-efficiency rank and auction-absorption rank at broad equal weights; the sleeve is always material when the portfolio is active and must be positive in bear.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Extreme taker flow versus closing-location disagreement may reveal liquidity absorption or failure; broad equal weights and a 6 percent symbol cap limit concentration, but no-control stress and tail gates remain empirical and non-compensatory.

falsifier: Stop the family if the exact no-control reference is insolvent or incomplete, has nonpositive annualized return, net or doubled-cost Sharpe at most zero, fewer than four profitable folds, nonpositive bull/bear/chop return, failed long-bull or short-bear role, or if absorption uplift U and composite rank IC are not positive in at least four of six folds. Controls cannot rescue a failed core. Any champion must later pass every full development and neighborhood gate.
mechanism: At each daily decision use only per-symbol completed 8h bars through t-8h. Rank a 12-day signed path-efficiency statistic and a three-bar exponentially smoothed gap between closing location and normalized taker-buy quote-volume imbalance; blend the ranks at fixed 60/40 weight. Long the top quarter and short the bottom quarter with equal side budgets, broad equal name weights, and a fixed 6 percent cap. No common-market factor, residualization, funding, reversal leg, state blend, or directional sleeve tilt is used.
risk_policy_plan: Begin with one exact no-control reference and stop on nonpositive core, regime, sleeve, cost, solvency, or causal-uplift evidence. Only after a complete positive no-control signal may a 20-day 35 percent volatility target and 10/20/27.5 percent drawdown brake be tested in the full none/individual/combined factorial at base and doubled costs. No position stop, time stop, turnover limit, side scale, or same-boundary reentry is allowed; risk controls cannot create eligibility for a failed alpha core.
selection_metric: Require all non-compensatory gates and the absorption-uplift falsifier first; then lexicographically maximize positive-fold count, worst-regime Sharpe, worst-fold Sharpe, doubled-cost Sharpe, median-fold Sharpe, aggregate Sharpe, and Calmar; then minimize drawdown and turnover, with bytewise candidate_id as final tie-break. Require at least seven of nine profitable declared neighbors and neighbor median Sharpe at least 0.50.
